items.rationale: Accept. The primary recipe author describes a cooked omelette served in bread slices as an omelette sandwich, with vegetables among optional additions. The explanation preserves cooking and assembly; the two selected concepts identify a recognizable filling and bread, rather than pretending they alone define an exact culinary formula. This gives the already discovered omelette a sensible reuse. No new identity, ingredient exclusivity, regional-origin claim or alcohol-dependent framing is introduced.

Accept. Laura Laurențiu’s own recipe combines fully boiled eggs with potatoes that are separately boiled, drained and cooled, then mixed with dressing. The candidate explicitly includes those preparation steps; it does not assert raw potato becomes ready salad merely by contact with an egg. Potato salad is an existing broad result and accommodates this familiar egg-containing variant without claiming all potato salads contain eggs. Reusing a cooked egg is semantically purposeful.

Accept. The original cooking guide specifically recommends baked potatoes, removes their skins, presses the flesh and folds in butter, followed by liquid dairy; it expressly allows milk in place of cream. The candidate accurately states mashing and peeling, so the result is mashed potato rather than simply baked potatoes with butter. This is a plausible alternate preparation using the existing baked-potato discovery, not a claim that baking is the only or standard Romanian method.

scope: Independent exact-byte raw factual review of three proposed reuse recipes only. Existing-world concepts and pairs checked against the currently pinned package; no full candidate publication or runtime play is accepted here. Final world/dossier/API review is required after assembly. Primary recipe pages opened and read during this review; no recipe text is copied into the game.
